V2_definition: Plastic_Bomo Generation V2 dataset protocol, not MSDF-v4 or adapter formatv2
baseline_name: repository-specific SD2 local inpainting implementation (class-fine-tuned V2 checkpoints; fixed 512-patch; weak-bbox condition; raw-bank protocol)
public_starting_weights: same locally hash-verified public sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2-inpainting assets as frozen Stage20B

common_generator_training_target.budget_unit: 2000 successful optimizer updates per class; attempted updates and AMP skips recorded separately
common_generator_training_target.trainable_parameter_dtype: float32 master parameters; never FP16 optimizer gradients
common_generator_training_target.loss: unweighted ordinary denoising MSE; target determined by public base training scheduler prediction_type

prompts.flash: a photo of a sks flash defect
prompts.black: a photo of a sks black spot defect

common_generator_training_target.training_order: annotation IDs sorted; deterministic per-class permutation seed42 + zero-based epoch
common_generator_training_target.augmentation: none; deterministic geometric crop and hard rectangular mask
common_generator_training_target.normal_background_policy: no extra normal-only generator training; masked donor crop is the denoising condition; frozen TRAIN normals only at inference
common_generator_training_target.checkpoint_save_rule: final pipeline only after 2000 successful updates; no validation checkpoint selection
common_generator_training_target.final_checkpoint_rule: class final_step2000 pipeline; hash all components; refuse if successful updates !=2000

mask_crop_policy.mask: L-mode rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive right/bottom
mask_crop_policy.mask_semantics: white inpaint, black retain; weak bbox geometry NOT segmentation ground truth
mask_crop_policy.output: paste generated 512 patch into the same full normal canvas at fixed crop origin; ignore padded pixels, no blending or quality selection
mask_crop_policy.synthetic_labels: only frozen target bbox; background normal has no dataset-defined boxes

common_generator_training_target.entrypoint: train_dreambooth_noise.py, pinned by Stage20A baseline code evidence; future manifest-only launch wrapper, not launched at P0

required_method_differences.difference: Full historical MSDFAdapter and zero-initialized up-block feature injection.
Six auxiliary objectives and the historical TRAIN saliency/support objective; unchanged coefficients.
Reference VAE-mode features and pre-VAE reference pixels; same-class cross reference0.30 and branch dropout0.20.
Historical TRAIN coarse-mask dilation radius24 and soft-prior blur radius2; unaugmented source mask remains the identical frozen V2 bbox rectangle.
required_method_differences.claim_limit: The transformed training conditioning is not numerically identical to raw baseline hard mask; report explicitly, do not claim strictly identical transformed masks.

required_method_differences.difference: Additional MSDF parameter group at historical LR1e-4; full UNet LR must match V2 baseline1e-6 rather than legacy default5e-6.
Legacy MSDF trains a doubled unconditional/conditional forward and optimizes its conditional prediction; retain CFG-aware injection behavior.
Manifest-only bound crops, baseline ordering/epoch-tail handling, tokenizer padding contract, actual optimizer-post-hook counts, complete checkpoint hash barrier.
Must use the same Stage20B sampling/crop/paste path plus existing MSDF prepare/hooks only; historical generic inference wrapper includes disallowed normal filtering and cannot be used unchanged.

generation_target.pipeline: StableDiffusionInpaintPipeline; standard inpainting only; no magic/dynamic/task-guidance branches
generation_target.safety_checker: disabled for industrial images; no safety-based sample replacement
generation_target.generator_device: CPU torch.Generator per slot; freshly seeded; record before/after state hashes at future runtime
generation_target.output_encoding: lossless RGB PNG for final full canvas; no JPEG re-encoding
generation_target.checkpoint: same newly trained V2 class final_step2000 checkpoint across banks, hash bound before ANY sampling

prompts.flash: a photo of a sks flash defect
prompts.black: a photo of a sks black spot defect

geometry_policy.mask: L-mode rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive right/bottom
geometry_policy.mask_semantics: white inpaint, black retain; weak bbox geometry NOT segmentation ground truth
geometry_policy.output: paste generated 512 patch into the same full normal canvas at fixed crop origin; ignore padded pixels, no blending or quality selection
geometry_policy.synthetic_labels: only frozen target bbox; background normal has no dataset-defined boxes

raw_output_policy.structural_failure_consequence: stop formal comparison if any frozen slot fails; do not replace it or silently reduce 40/40

training.early_stopping: explicitly disabled in future trainer, not merely hidden by val=False
training.final_eval_during_or_at_train_end: forbidden; override trainer final_eval automatic validation
training.accumulation_rule: fixed 64 draws; reset each epoch, flush the 24-draw tail, normalize each accumulation group by actual draw count; warmup changes LR/momentum only, never accumulation; future trainer must enforce this schedule
training.augmentation_rng: per draw fresh seed = first64bits SHA256(protocol + 'augmentation' + '42' + epoch + position); same across arms; no global RNG consumption coupling
training.runtime_version_policy: actual SERVER_P0 installed package versions and trainer/default/loss/optimizer source hashes are frozen; no package upgrades during Stage20B
training.unsupported_args_policy: stop; do not silently omit or substitute frozen hyperparameters

detector_target.enforcement: Future custom trainer must enforce scheduled optimizer attempts, per-draw RNG, 150 epochs and NO final_eval() call; no trainer implemented or launched at P0

barriers: P0 all five hard conditions plus TRAIN-only finite forward/backward; safety optimizer.step=0
both class generator checkpoints frozen before formal generation
all three MSDF epoch150 detector checkpoints frozen before unified final_eval
bank_SD: sample standard deviation, ddof=1; not detector-seed uncertainty
final_eval_status: Historically observed in Stage20B. NOT an untouched independent final test. No method/seed/sample/checkpoint tuning based on Stage25 final_eval.
